title: Battery Electrolyte NMP Exposure Monitoring Record
description: Evidence model for N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP) vapor inhalation exposure monitoring and local-exhaust-ventilation verification during lithium-ion electrolyte mixing, filling, and solvent recovery operations. NMP is a reproductive toxicant regulated under CCA and OSHA-KR MSDS provisions.

nmp_twa_ppm.description: 8-hour time-weighted average NMP vapor concentration (ppm) at the operator breathing zone.

respiratory_ppe_worn.description: True if supplied-air or organic-vapor respirator was worn during the task.
